'''Rogue Null''' was the callsign used by [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] when flying the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Forbidden]]'' in support of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].
